QuickStats: Age-Adjusted Death Rates* for Motor Vehicle Traffic Injury
In 2016, the death rate in the United States for motor vehicle traffic injury was 11.7 per 100,000 standard population.
New York (5.3), Rhode Island (5.0), and the District of Columbia (4.5) had the lowest rates.
QuickStats: Age-Adjusted Death Rates* for Motor Vehicle Traffic Injury
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Underlying cause of death data, 2016.

methods_quotes.q: Rates are deaths per 100,000 standard population.
